mapper.sql: c.id, c.seed_key, c.title, c.suggest_start_day, c.suggest_end_day, c.suggested_date, c.appointment_date, c.appointment_time, c.hospital, c.location, c.completed_date, c.focus, c.status, c.request_id, c.request_hash, c.version, c.create_by, c.create_time, c.update_by, c.update_time, c.remark, c.del_flag
mapper.select: select from preg_checkup c where c.del_flag = '0' order by case when c.appointment_date is null then 1 else 0 end, c.appointment_date asc, c.suggest_start_day asc, c.id asc
select from preg_checkup c where c.id = #{id} and c.del_flag = '0'
select from preg_checkup c where c.del_flag = '0' order by c.id for update
select from preg_checkup c where c.seed_key = #{seedKey} limit 1
select from preg_checkup c where c.request_id = #{requestId} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into preg_checkup ( seed_key, title, suggest_start_day, suggest_end_day, suggested_date, appointment_date, appointment_time, hospital, location, completed_date, focus, status, request_id, request_hash, version, create_by, create_time ) values ( #{seedKey}, #{title}, #{suggestStartDay}, #{suggestEndDay}, #{suggestedDate}, #{appointmentDate}, #{appointmentTime}, #{hospital}, #{location}, #{completedDate}, #{focus}, #{status}, #{requestId}, #{requestHash}, 1, #{createBy}, now(3) )
mapper.update: update preg_checkup set title = #{title}, suggested_date = #{suggestedDate}, appointment_date = #{appointmentDate}, appointment_time = #{appointmentTime}, hospital = #{hospital}, location = #{location}, completed_date = #{completedDate}, focus = #{focus}, status = #{status}, version = version + 1, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now(3) where id = #{id} and version = #{version} and del_flag = '0'
update preg_checkup set version = version + 1, update_time = now(3) where id = #{id} and version = #{version} and del_flag = '0'
update preg_checkup set del_flag = '2', version = version + 1, update_time = now(3) where id = #{id} and version = #{version} and del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: select from preg_checkup c where c.del_flag = '0' and (c.appointment_date = #{date} or c.completed_date = #{date}) order by c.appointment_time asc, c.id asc

select d.record_date as recordDate, count(1) as total from ( select c.appointment_date as record_date from preg_checkup c where c.del_flag = '0' and c.appointment_date is not null union all select c.completed_date as record_date from preg_checkup c where c.del_flag = '0' and c.completed_date is not null ) d where d.record_date >= #{from} and d.record_date <= #{to} group by d.record_date

select d.id, d.checkup_id, d.type, d.title, d.description, d.sort_order, d.estimated_minutes, d.done, d.done_at, d.done_by from preg_checkup_detail d where d.checkup_id = #{checkupId} and d.del_flag = '0' order by d.type asc, d.sort_order asc, d.id asc
mapper.insert:
insert into preg_checkup_detail ( checkup_id, type, title, description, sort_order, estimated_minutes, done, create_time, update_time ) values
(#{item.checkupId}, #{item.type}, #{item.title}, #{item.description}, #{item.sortOrder}, #{item.estimatedMinutes}, 0, now(3), now(3))
mapper.update: update preg_checkup_detail set del_flag = '2', update_time = now(3) where checkup_id = #{checkupId} and type = #{type} and del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: select d.id, d.checkup_id, d.type, d.title, d.description, d.sort_order, d.estimated_minutes, d.done, d.done_at, d.done_by from preg_checkup_detail d where d.id = #{id} and d.del_flag = '0'
mapper.update: update preg_checkup_detail set done = #{done}, done_at = case when #{done} = 1 then now(3) else null end, done_by = #{doneBy}, update_time = now(3) where id = #{id} and type = 'PREPARATION' and del_flag = '0'
